name: wpthb coupled receiver
assumptions: Secondary is assumed identical to the primary, not supplied receiver hardware.
Receiver series capacitor is tuned per operating frequency; its AC-equivalent resistor maximizes sinusoidal link efficiency.
Target receiver power is obtained by adjusting phase at 24 V, not by imposing a fixed power sink.
Switch and passive parasitics are editable engineering placeholders, not extracted manufacturer values.
Coil core conductance is fitted to small-signal Q=155 at 125 kHz and held constant; broadband/large-signal/temperature behavior is not measured.
Input filter is electrical; upstream copper, coil geometry, gate circuitry and environment coupling are not field-modeled.
matching_definition: Receiver capacitor and load are held at supplied secondary_C_F/load_ohm, otherwise tuned/efficiency-matched per frequency. Primary C fixed. Phase regulates load power.
circuit_backend: ngspice; finite transition bidirectional conductance / NMOS / external D,G,S subcircuit
field_inference: Band-limited periodic copper fields inferred from transient port currents; passive broadband Foster feedback is approximate; no full-wave/common-mode compliance prediction.
